title: Peter Schlemihl
author: Adelbert von Chamisso
description: "Peter Schlemihl" by Adelbert von Chamisso is a novella written in 1814.
longDescription: A man trades his shadow to the Devil for a bottomless wallet, only to discover that society shuns anyone without a shadow.

authorInfo.bio: Adelbert von Chamisso (1781–1838) wrote Peter Schlemihl. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
